items.fact: The campaign is divided into five chapters, and PC Gamer counts 91 story missions in total. Other outlets give different totals, so the count depends on how optional missions are handled.

Game Rant lays out the chapter structure with each chapter's main location and mission count. Chapter 1 has 22 missions around the Leonida Keys, Chapter 2 has 11 plus 3 optional around Port Gellhorn, Chapter 3 has 26 plus 1 optional in Vice City, Chapter 4 has 25 in Vice City, and Chapter 5 has 7 a…
Video Games Chronicle states there are 5 chapters and 95 main missions. This is higher than PC Gamer's total, so counts differ between guides.
The chapter titles are Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost, Tits Ass Drug Money, Vice City Baby, and Top of the World Ma. Chapter 1 opens with a Prologue in which Lucia meets her prison counselor.
The point of no return in Chapter 2 is the start of the Checking Out mission. Finish any optional Chapter 2 content before you begin it.
Jason and Lucia are the two playable leads and a criminal couple. Supporting characters named in the missions include Brian, Cal, Donnie, Dre'Quan, Raul, Randy, Moses and Kenton.
Leonida is split into five counties. Named places include Key Lento, Port Gellhorn in Kelly County, Moreau in Lummox County, and Vice City.
There are 18 collectible card sets, and each set mixes common and rare cards. Collecting three cards in each of the 5 counties unlocks the Collectible Cards achievement.
The map has 33 Underwater Discovery locations. Many of them hold Kenton's Treasures, which you dig up with a metal detector and sell to Kenton.
The WAiNK landmark collectibles come in three types: 35 Curiosities, 31 Landmarks and 23 Sculptures.
There are 27 Magazines, Books and Comics to find. They are counted separately from Book Swaps.
Racing is spread across the map, with 40 unique race locations. Entry and vehicle rental fees apply, and a win pays more than you paid in.
Demolition derbies at Ambrosia Raceway can be repeated. A win on the oval track pays over $3,000, and the figure-eight track pays about double.
Stolen cars sell to Moses from Chapter 2, but only if they have no tracker. Randy's high-end wish list of 18 sports cars pays $30,000 or more per car from partway through Chapter 3.
Large bank vault robberies, which unlock near the end of Chapter 4, can pay up to $200,000. They bring an instant 4-star wanted level.
There are 39 criminal hideouts across Leonida. The Three Sheets liquor store in Chapter 1 has an illegal operation worth a few thousand dollars.
Wait until Chapter 3 before robbing banks or loan stores. Their cash carries dye packs, and you need a dye pack jammer to avoid them.
Rob places with medium or high security as a pair. Check the map for back doors, because the snap gun lets you enter without setting off alarms.
RydeMe fast travel costs $100 in Kotaku's testing. The buses and trains are a cheaper alternative, but they run on schedules.
The Scooter Bros phone app lets you spawn and repair your owned vehicles and pull them out of impound, all for a fee. A premium tier gives three free uses per in-game day.
You can repair a car or motorcycle for a small fee at any gas pump. You can also buy garages around the map to store more vehicles.

Update 01.002.002 is the first post-launch patch, released November 23, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It fixes crashes, autosave failures, weather that never changed, story phone calls that failed to trigger, a Wanted Level that couldn't be lost, the gym deadlift bar, and partners not handing ov…
The first patch is small, about 603.8 MB on PS5 and 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S. The full game is 211 GB.
The patch notes do not mention the first-person glitch or the Xbox glitch that unlocks 60fps, so both appeared to still work after the update.
